html:
core/tokens/motion/genie.ts

Expand-modal genie-warp tunables — the macOS-style liquid
Sourcesrc/core/tokens/motion/genie.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

STRIPS

Strip tessellation cap — the scratch arrays size to STRIPS+1. The per-frame band count is adaptive: sheet height ÷ STRIP_TARGET_PX, floored at MIN_STRIPS and capped here. 256 bounds the buffers and the worst-case draw cost; typical viewports land near 180 bands.

STRIP_TARGET_PX

Target band height (CSS px) — the strip pitch. ≈5px per band keeps the funnel's sloped walls raster-smooth on a 900px sheet (180 parallelogram draws ≈ 3.2ms of setTransform+drawImage on mid-range hardware — inside the 4.16ms desktop frame slice); the previous fixed 96 strips stair-stepped the walls at ~9px pitch.

MIN_STRIPS

Floor band count — very small sheets still get enough rows for the staggered field to read as a continuous funnel instead of a handful of sliding bands.

STAGGER_X

Horizontal stagger — each row's x-clock starts at (1−ty)·STAGGER_X of the run, so the figure-facing edge leads and the far edge trails. 0.65 is the reference value: deep enough for the walls to read as a liquid S-curve, shallow enough that the trailing edge never feels abandoned.

STAGGER_Y

Vertical stagger — same trick on the y-clock. Kept small (0.2 in the reference): the collapse stays mostly uniform vertically while the leading edge dips into the card first.

GLOW_START

Dock-flash window — the radial white burst at the figure's center starts when funnel progress passes 0.75 and eases out (1−(1−t)²) to GLOW_ALPHA as the sheet lands. Matches the reference's last quarter accent.

GLOW_ALPHA

Dock-flash peak alpha — subtle white bloom, never a hard flash.

GLOW_RADIUS_FRAC

Dock-flash radius as a fraction of the figure's short edge — the reference uses a fixed 55px around a 50px icon; scaling by the card keeps the bloom proportional on large media figures.

MIN_BAND_PX

Minimum drawn band height (CSS px). Contiguous bands can collapse to zero/negative height where the funnel neck inverts the strip order mid-flight; bands under it skip the draw (a sub-pixel sliver is invisible anyway).

EDGE_OVERDRAW_PX

Per-band overdraw (CSS px) on the parallelogram strip pass — each band's quad is extended by this on its right wall and floor so the antialiased seams between neighbours never open sub-pixel cracks along the funnel's diagonal walls (opaque texture, so the double paint is invisible).

TEX_MAX_PX

Sheet-texture long-edge cap (device px) — the composited modal surface bakes at min(dpr, TEX_MAX_PX / longest edge). 2560 keeps a 1440p sheet at ~1.8× (crisp through the 700ms warp) without an unbounded framebuffer on dpr-3 mobile.

GENIE_TIMING

Progress driver — a duration clock over linear time. p = opening ? 1−raw : raw: the close runs 0→1 (modal → figure) and the open evaluates the identical field in time-reverse — the literal reverse animation macOS plays on restore — so both directions share one liquid surface. No global easing curve: the reference is linear-time by design — the motion character lives entirely in the per-row staggered eases (x rows ease-in-out, y rows ease-in so the suck accelerates into the card).

OPEN_MS

Open run duration (ms).

CLOSE_MS

Close run duration (ms) — slightly longer, the suck needs runway.

DT_MAX_S

Per-frame integration step cap (seconds) — a suspended tab resumes with a finite dt so the driver's frame ticks never lurch.

MOUNT_MS

Async GPU-mount budget (ms) — the WebGPU/Rust backend mounts off-tick (wasm instantiate + shader compile); under throttle that can outlast the whole transition and the watchdog would settle before the first frame — the "blink" failure mode. The 2D backend runs the identical field and attaches instantly, so the mount is raced: GPU wins when it resolves inside this window, otherwise 2D owns the run and the late renderer is disposed.

MAX_MS

Hard cap on the run (ms) — a wedged rAF or a pathological clock can never latch the overlay; past this the session force-settles and hands control back to the modal.

GENIE_FALLBACK

Timing fallbacks — the degraded paths when the canvas route cannot run (reduced motion, missing 2D context, widget mount failure).

OPEN_MS

Open veil duration (ms) when the genie cannot play — matches the legacy modal-zoom-in keyframe time so the fallback keeps the old rhythm.

CLOSE_MS

Close duration (ms) — matches the legacy modal-zoom-out keyframe and the existing teardown delay in expanded/close.ts.
